get.description: Retrieves a list of custom models from Datarobot.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

created.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when the custom model was created.

createdBy.description: The username of the custom model creator.

deploymentsCount.description: The number of deployments for the custom model.

description.description: The description of the custom model.

id.description: The ID of the custom model.

language.description: The programming language used to write the model.

latestVersion.description: The latest version of the custom model.

name.description: The name of the custom model.

supportsBinaryClassification.description: Whether the model supports binary classification.

targetType.description: The target type of the custom model.

updated.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when the custom model was last updated.

userProvidedId.description: A user-provided unique ID associated with the custom model.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.
